info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides a streamlined way to access estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for rideshare services. By retrieving real-time data about ride requests, this API enables developers to enhance user experience with timely updates. Typical consumers include rideshare application developers and transport management systems that require accurate ETA projections to improve service efficiency. This API facilitates better planning and coordination for users seeking rideshare options.

get.summary: Retrieve the estimated time of arrival for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to get the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a requested ride based on the current traffic conditions and location. It's useful for passengers to plan their arrival times effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for obtaining estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. This request includes necessary parameters to retrieve the ETA based on specified ride and location details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved estimated time of arrival.
